text: Charitable Donations Donations to recognized charitable organizations are covered in this topic. What qualifies? Donations made by cash, check, credit card, or payroll deduction Out-of-pocket expenses to perform volunteer work Vehicle expenses Donations of clothing, toys, household items, and other types of property Carryover of a charitable deduction that was disallowed in a prior year What doesn't qualify? Cost of raffle, bingo, or lottery tickets Value of your time or services
